name: Tan Ky House
kicker: Lived-in merchant house on Nguyễn Thái Học
summary: A lived-in merchant house at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học, the shop at the front and the river at the back, with no windows and light falling in from the courts. Chinese characters run down the columns and the family still lives upstairs, so the ground floor is the visit. Allow well under an hour, in the morning.
fee: 20,000 VND from 10 Aug 2026, or a combination ticket
heroCaption: The timber front of Tan Ky House on Nguyễn Thái Học

notice.title: Come before the midday break
notice.body: The house lists a break from 11:30 to 13:30 and closes in the late afternoon, so it is not a night sight. The family lives upstairs: keep your voice down and do not touch the objects.

body: Walk in at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học. The house runs back toward the Thu Bồn at the Châu Thượng Văn junction, with no windows and light from the courts. Chinese characters sit on the columns, and a glass case holds a cup known as the Confucius cup. The ground floor is the visit. The family lives upstairs. Do not touch the objects.
Old houses are optional stops on the old-town ticket. Come in the morning, before the midday break, and leave the night for the streets outside.

figures.caption: Inlaid furniture on the ground floor
figures.alt: Inlaid wooden furniture and a carved screen inside Tan Ky House in Hoi An

gettingThere: The house is at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học, the street closer to the river than Trần Phú. Walk from the lanes off the old town.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk along Nguyễn Thái Học to number 101.

hours: 08:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:45 daily (creative-city visitor page); not repeated on the 2026 ticket notice. Check on arrival.
closed: Midday break 11:30–13:30 on the visitor page.
admissionNote: No separate price for this building. From 10 Aug 2026: 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for every visitor (Da Nang Resolution 98/2026). Heritage centre notices of 26 Jan and 16 Mar 2026: 80,000 VND (streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works) or 120,000 VND (adds a museum and three other works), usable through a stay of up to three days. A May 2026 article counts those as four and six works. Ask at the booth which ticket is on sale.
